name: bounded-period objective alternation
causal_support: STRONG - direct parameter sweep in Kashtan/Noor/Alon 2007 plus the 2005 modularity-decay intervention
statement: Alternating the objective at a period bounded below by the system's reconfiguration time under its own variation operator, and above by the unaided single-objective solution time, produces large reductions in time-to-solution relative to a fixed objective.
verbatim_basis: For efficient speedup, the switching time of the goals should be larger than the minimal time it takes to rewire the networks to achieve each new goal and shorter than the time it takes to solve a fixed goal. In the present examples, the former is usually on the order of a few generations, and the latter is usually 10^3 generations or larger.
measured_effect: MVG S_max 95x/265x/700x/60x/25x across five substrates on the hardest goals; band spans ~3 orders of magnitude in switch period; E=20 used throughout
non_biological_restatement: temporal variation of the objective at a scale allowing retention of shared substructure while preventing complete specialization to any one objective
caveats: the SPEED half of this part does NOT require the objectives to share structure - see PART-MVG-02. Both bounds are directly measurable in any candidate world before choosing a period.
portability_to_SFE: HIGH - substrate independent, requires only a measurable reconfiguration time and solution time

name: unstructured objective perturbation as plateau escape
status: REGISTERED - and it is a WARNING part, not a capability part
causal_support: STRONG - 2007 Table 1 RVG_v and VG_0 columns, plus the explicit landscape mapping
statement: A large fraction of the acceleration attributed to structured environmental variation is obtainable from UNSTRUCTURED variation, including alternation with pure neutral drift, and is a generic search-dynamics effect with no representational content.
verbatim_basis: RVG_v seems to help by pushing the population in a random direction, thereby rescuing it from fitness plateaus or local maxima.
measured_effect: RVG_v S_max 45x/160x/10x/3x in four of five models; VG_0 (no selection at all in alternate epochs) reaches 190x in feed-forward circuits against MVG's 265x. Meanwhile 2005 reports randomly varying goals produce NO modular structure.
consequence: speed and representational restructuring DISSOCIATE. Any Prometheus experiment claiming a representational cause for an acceleration MUST include an unstructured-variation arm, not merely a fixed-environment arm. The 2008 accessibility experiments lack this arm.
portability_to_SFE: HIGH as a required control condition

name: environmentally-maintained alignment of the variation operator
causal_support: MODERATE - longitudinal measurement plus a cause-side intervention; the mediator itself was never perturbed (see D_LEVEL_ADJUDICATION.md)
statement: Under repeated exposure to objectives sharing a fixed decomposition, the genotype-phenotype map comes to organise mutational effects along that decomposition - larger effects within a module, smaller effects across modules - and the single-mutation phenotypic neighborhood becomes stocked with previously rewarded phenotypes.
verbatim_basis: the phenotypic neighborhood of MVG-evolved genomes includes phenotypes that have high fitness to the past goals seen in their history ... the evolved organism effectively remembers its past goals by storing information about it in its genome
measured_effect: pleiotropy 0.04 -> 0.01 in circuits (p<1e-4); intra-module effect up in both substrates; FV trajectory rises significantly faster than FG over 1e5 generations, 30-40 runs per condition
reservation_1: NOT A RATCHET. The property decays rapidly when the environment is made constant (2008 Fig 9D; 2005 Fig 3 for modularity). It is maintained, not accumulated. This part cannot by itself produce compounding.
reservation_2: the pleiotropy leg did NOT replicate in RNA (Table 1, NS). Substrate-dependent.
reservation_3: the FG comparison arm carried a gate-count penalty the MVG arm did not - a live confound.
portability_to_SFE: HIGH for the measurement; the phenomenon should be treated as a target to be re-established, not an inherited fact

name: cheap acquisition of novel content within a fixed compositional scheme
causal_support: STRONG for the effect, STRONG for the boundary
statement: An organism whose variation operator has been aligned to a compositional scheme acquires previously UNSEEN functional content occupying a slot in that scheme more cheaply than a fixed-goal organism, and acquires nothing more cheaply outside the scheme.
verbatim_basis_positive: Novel-module refers to goals where one of the subgoals is a previously unseen one, while the other subgoals are kept unchanged ... populations were taken over by MVG-genomes in about 70% of the runs
verbatim_basis_boundary: We find that MVG's outperformance occurred only toward goals within the modularity language. MVG adaptation toward non-modular goals was not significantly different from FG's.
measured_effect: 20 novel-module goals x 30 simulations; ~70% competition takeover inside the language; 50/50 outside it, with difficulty matched
consequence: the saving is in the MODULE, not in the ARCHITECTURE. This is the specimen of the whole deep-dive.
portability_to_SFE: the RESULT does not transfer as a capability; the EXPERIMENTAL DESIGN (in-language vs out-of-language held-out families, difficulty-matched) transfers directly and is the correct shape for any Prometheus transfer test

name: localized environmental memory (genetic triggers)
status: REGISTERED AS HYPOTHESIS ONLY - causal function NOT established
causal_support: WEAK - identified by mutual information, never perturbed
statement: Information about which environment is current is stored at a small number of identifiable genomic positions, at which single mutations produce large prepared phenotypic responses with low cross-module effect.
verbatim_basis: Since trigger positions are small variations that lead to a sizable switch between pre-designed states, they may be considered as a simple example of weak regulatory linkage.
why_not_fully_registered: no knockout, freezing, transplant or randomisation experiment exists. The detector also has two unaddressed statistical defects (MI upward bias on sparse histograms with no random-pairing null; argmax over loci with no null distribution). Registering the causal function would be crediting a correlation.
highest_value_followup: this is the handle for the missing D5 experiment - disable triggers while holding fitness and modularity constant, then measure acquisition

name: self-adaptive variation machinery under recurring environmental structure
status: REGISTERED AS UNTESTED COMPOSITION - DO NOT RUN, per assignment
statement: An evolving system whose representation can restructure its own variation distribution (Toussaint line) placed under environmental regularity that selects for variation machinery preserving and recombining useful substructure (Kashtan/Alon line).
why_it_is_a_composition_and_not_a_duplic: In the Kashtan/Alon substrate the variation operator is FIXED by the experimenter - a per-locus mutation rate and a crossover probability, never itself evolved. The restructuring occurs in the genotype-phenotype map, not in the variation operator. Toussaint's line makes the exploration distribution itself heritable and self-adapting. Neither programme supplies the other's half.
search_status: SEARCH COMPLETE. The composition is ASSERTED IN PRINT AND NEVER RUN. Fernando C, Szathmary E, Husbands P (2012), Front Comput Neurosci 6:24, state it directly: the Parter/Kashtan/Alon facilitated-variation effect 'occurs if there is non-trivial neutrality as described by Toussaint (2003) and demonstrated for gene regulatory networks (Izquierdo and Fernando, 2008)' - citing the same 2003 PhD thesis the house Toussaint specimen is built on, and offering as demonstration a DIFFERENT paper on a DIFFERENT substrate. Nobody ran it on Kashtan/Alon's systems. Near-miss rejected: Reisinger & Miikkulainen 2006 generalises Kashtan's varying fitness function and cites Toussaint, but only as a reference to unrelated work, with zero engagement in prose. Co-citation without composition confirmed in Kouvaris 2017 and Watson & Szathmary 2016. Residual uncertainty: a full forward-citation sweep of the thesis was blocked by HTTP 429.
status_upgrade: this is now stronger than an untested idea - it is a NAMED, PUBLISHED, UNTESTED HYPOTHESIS with a citable claimant, which makes it a better candidate than one Prometheus invented
prediction_if_run: the decay result (2008 Fig 9D, independently confirmed by Espinosa-Soto 2018 'Once fluctuations stop, modularity drops abruptly') is the reason to expect this composition to matter: a fixed variation operator cannot retain alignment when the environment stops supplying structure. A heritable, self-adapting operator might. That is the mechanism by which a mirror could become a ratchet, and it is exactly what neither lineage tested.

name: external replication status of the MVG specimen
status: REGISTERED AS A CONSTRAINT ON USE, not a part
statement: The MVG effect is SINGLE-LABORATORY and CONTESTED. The only independent replication attempt of any arm reversed the sign; the arm carrying every accessibility result has never been independently tested.
verbatim_basis: Clune, Beckmann, McKinley & Ofria 2010 (GECCO '10 635-642), retina arm with a direct-encoding control: 'the MVG regimes performed worse than the FG-AND regime, which was the opposite of what occurred in Kashtan and Alon's study.' Controls closed: Kashtan's own switching rate E=20 plus faster and slower, 20 runs per treatment, population 500, extended to 30,000 generations.
their_diagnosis: discreteness of the representation - 'Mutations between a few discrete values may have a larger effect on the network output, making it more likely that single mutations can switch between a solution to FG-OR and FG-AND.' This CONVERGES with PART-MVG-06 from the opposite direction: a group trying to refute the lineage located the same operative condition (one-mutation switchability between successive goals) that Kashtan's own hidden NBVG control identifies.
reproducibility_note: the same 2010 paper records that 'the description of their model is not complete', an external confirmation that the 2005 genotype-phenotype map cannot be reconstructed from the published text. No code was ever released.
consequence: house calibration particle cal-08 must be marked CONTESTED and withheld from the detector-scoring set. The specimen's usable value is its CONTROL SET DESIGN and its status as an open reproduction target, not its numbers.

name: neutral-network-border positioning with localized triggers
status: REGISTERED - and it displaces modularity as the mechanism of layer 1
causal_support: STRONG - supported by the authors' own non-modular control (NBVG), Text S1 section 2.1 and Figure S3
statement: Repeated switching between objectives whose SOLUTION SETS ARE CLOSE IN GENOTYPE SPACE - regardless of whether those objectives are modularly related - positions the population at the border between neutral networks and concentrates environmental memory in a small number of high-mutual-information genomic positions, producing rapid re-adaptation on environment change.
verbatim_basis: We find that the evolutionary dynamics of NBVG is very similar to that of MVG, with respect to the rapid adaptation when environment changes. The design and the mechanisms that underlie this rapid adaptation are equivalent to that of MVG and include the location of genomes at the border of the neutral networks and the evolution of small number of genetic triggers (Fig. S3).
construction_recipe: to build a non-modular but nearby goal pair: sample genomes from the G1 neutral network, enumerate their phenotypic neighborhood, rank candidate target phenotypes by frequency of appearance in that neighborhood, and select one of approximately MEDIAN rank that is neither trivial nor decomposable. This is a reusable world-construction primitive and it is fully specified in the source.
why_it_matters: it separates the mechanism (genotype-space proximity of successive objectives) from the property most often credited with it (modularity). A world designer can therefore obtain layer-1 rapid re-adaptation WITHOUT authoring a decomposition at all - which is precisely the authored-curriculum escape route.
portability_to_SFE: HIGH and it is the most Prometheus-relevant part in this file, because it shows how to build a varying world whose structure is defined by REACHABILITY rather than by a human-legible decomposition.

name: non-monotonic response of variation bias to environmental variability
causal_support: MODERATE - three-arm comparison reported in Text S1 with 30 and 15 simulations per arm; no perturbation
statement: The bias of the variation distribution toward useful novel phenotypes is NOT monotonic in how much the environment changes. Structured change raises it, no change leaves it at an intermediate level driven by robustness, and unstructured change LOWERS it below the static case.
verbatim_basis: Environments that change in a non-random modular fashion enhance evolution of non-random, facilitated-variation. Environments that change in a more random fashion evolve organisms with a more random, un-biased phenotypic variation, with very low FV measures. Finally, environments that do not change at all (FG) evolve organisms with a medium level of facilitated variation (due to increased in robustness).
consequence: a two-arm design (static vs varying) can produce EITHER sign of effect depending on which varying arm is chosen. Any Prometheus experiment on environmental variation needs at least three arms: static, structured-varying, unstructured-varying.
portability_to_SFE: HIGH as a required experimental design constraint

name: modularity as the causal mediator of acceleration
status: REJECTED - registered so it is not re-proposed
statement: The claim that modularly varying goals speed evolution BECAUSE they produce modular organisms is not supported by the corpus that is usually cited for it.
evidence_against: (i) 2005 reports randomly varying goals produce no modular structure while 2007 Table 1 reports they produce 45x, 160x, 10x and 3x speedups in four of five models - so modularity is not necessary for acceleration. (ii) In feed-forward circuits, alternation with NO SELECTION (VG_0) yields 190x against MVG's 265x. (iii) DECISIVE: the authors' own NBVG control (Text S1 s2.1) produces rapid adaptation and the SAME underlying mechanisms as MVG using goals explicitly chosen to be non-decomposable.
correct_reading: Two layers. Layer 1 (speed, memory of seen goals) is caused by genotype-space proximity of successive goals and is obtainable without modularity. Layer 2 (biased neighborhood, generalisation to novel in-family goals) does require the shared structure to be modular - MVG and NBVG differ on exactly this in Fig S4. Conflating the layers is the lineage's most commonly repeated overstatement.
